# A static dock consumer's closure stays free of transaction modules

Leaf of #18605 (parent linked natively; blocked by the published-truth leaf) — the closure receipt, F7. `Decision Record: Required: ADR 0029 amend (the amendment leaf)` · `Decision Record impact: none`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection — the last leaf, run once the three engine leaves have merged.

## Context

#18474's stage one shipped with an instrument that pins the module closure of a static single-window consumer (`test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockImportDirection.spec.mjs` at `dev@28e56e1543` — verify the instrument's name at claim). The selection path must not drag the Group machinery into a standalone workspace.

## The Problem

The selection leaf adds replay transport in the transaction tier and the published-truth leaf adds a post-commit writer; either can pull `manager/Transaction`, `transaction/History` or `persistence/TopologyLibrary` into a consumer that never uses a Group or a library. Nothing asserts it does not.

## The Fix

Extend the stage-one instrument with an `activePerspective_` consumer (declared perspectives, a bound switcher, one switch) and assert the closure.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After the three engine leaves merge, the instrument asserts that a single-window consumer with declared perspectives and one switch gains no `manager/Transaction`, `transaction/History` or `persistence/TopologyLibrary` module in its static closure.
- [ ] The receipt is cited at one head with the spec's hash in #18605's closeout.
- [ ] The PR `Refs #18605` and `Resolves` this leaf only.

## Out of Scope

Bundle size of the Group path itself.
